name: Doppelgänger
source:
A game created by the Holostars EN team.

The story is set in an alternate universe where the player is struggling with the memories of what they know to be TEMPUS and the mysterious look-alikes who pull them every which way.

Can the player figure out the truth about this twisted world and return to the guild?

[from [url=https://ccmc-corp.itch.io/doppelganger]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
由Holostars EN团队制作的游戏。

故事发生在另一个宇宙中，玩家在与他们所知道的TEMPUS和那些神秘的相似者的记忆中挣扎，他们把他们拉向各个方向。

玩家能否查明这个扭曲世界的真相并重返公会呢？

[来自[url=https://ccmc-corp.itch.io/doppelganger]itch.io[/url]]
